purpose: Test whether independently established Cu(111) substrate evidence can be inherited across a different reaction while all H2-specific adsorption, dissociation, saddle, mode, dissipation and kinetic quantities remain independently established and separately typed.

capital_chi_scope.target_record: typed partial-or-full system record only to the extent independently licensed evidence exists

primary_thermal_rate_source.citation: Nitz et al., Thermal Rates and High-Temperature Tunneling from Surface Reaction Dynamics and First-Principles, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 146, 31538-31546 (2024)
known_comparator_facts: thermal adsorption and recombinative-desorption rates are reported over 200-1000 K
reported dissociative adsorption barrier is 0.619 +/- 0.020 eV
nuclear quantum tunneling is reported to remain important into the several-hundred-kelvin regime
primary_thermal_rate_source.allowed_role: held-out external comparator after method and numerical choices are frozen
primary_thermal_rate_source.forbidden_role: must not select or tune XC functional, pseudopotential, cutoff, slab depth, vacuum, k mesh, supercell, adsorption geometry, reaction path, barrier threshold, quantum-treatment settings, friction model or acceptance threshold

electronic_friction_source.citation: Spiering and Meyer, Testing Electronic Friction Models: Vibrational De-excitation in Scattering of H2 and D2 from Cu(111), J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 9, 1803-1808 (2018)
electronic_friction_source.known_exposure: LDFA and orbital-dependent friction are published for the six-dimensional H2/Cu(111) problem; anisotropic reaction-coordinate friction can differ substantially near the transition state while sticking probabilities can be comparatively insensitive.
electronic_friction_source.allowed_role: define candidate dissipation observables and later external comparison only
electronic_friction_source.forbidden_role: must not tune the new barrier/path calculation to match published friction-dependent outcomes

inheritance_allowed_only_if: CO/Cu(111) clean Cu(111) L19 extension reaches its frozen scientific PASS state
the accepted Cu(111) substrate artifact and all relevant numerical identities are preserved by hash/provenance
System 4 uses a compatible Cu pseudopotential family, bulk reference, electrostatic convention and slab construction or explicitly revalidates any changed item
may_inherit: clean Cu bulk lattice/numerical reference where method-compatible
clean Cu(111) slab depth/vacuum/k-density evidence where method-compatible
clean-surface provenance and exact runtime identities where applicable
must_not_inherit: CO adsorption geometry or site ordering
any H2 dissociation path or saddle
substrate_inheritance_contract.failure_rule: If the CO/Cu(111) substrate gate remains HOLD or if System 4 changes a substrate-defining method choice, System 4 must perform its own prospectively frozen clean Cu(111) substrate convergence rather than treating the CO result as inherited evidence.

work_authorized_before_substrate_inherit: H pseudopotential provenance and transferability qualification independent of target rate/barrier agreement
isolated H2 molecular-reference numerical checks independent of surface target outcomes
supercell/coverage discovery-plan freeze without inspecting H2/Cu target energies
build code/tests/workflow in dry-run or non-target preflight mode
target_surface_work_blocked_until_substr: target surface path or saddle search
surface rate calculation used for comparator evaluation

method_selection_rule.principle: Choose and freeze the lowest-cost method that passes non-kinetic numerical, pseudopotential, gas-phase molecular and clean-substrate structural gates.
method_selection_rule.note: The 2024 comparator paper used experimentally derived barrier information to validate/select its production PES. That is valuable published science but cannot be reused as an independent method-selection route for this prospectively tested System 4 record.

planned_system4_sequence: S4-0 evidence firewall and provenance freeze
S4-1 H pseudopotential plus isolated-H2 numerical qualification
S4-2 resolve Cu(111) substrate inheritance or launch independent substrate convergence
S4-3 prospectively frozen H2 coverage/supercell screen
S4-4 dissociative adsorption path and saddle
S4-6 independently sourced dissipation mapping with refusal if projection is not licensed
S4-8 nuclear-quantum rate tier if compute and convergence gates are satisfied
S4-9 held-out experimental comparison and typed capital-Chi assembly
